race.comment: BE A BEAUTY (3) rocketed out of the boxes with a strong early sectional but gathered in and finished in the minors when second (16.94) at this track over 300m. Winning claims. LAVERS GINNY (4) was narrowly beaten when placing two back but missed the frame latest finishing eighth (17.41) in a Grade 5 at this track. Can feature with the right run. ALWAYS SPEEDY (6) was a last-start winner from box one at this track and distance (17.04) after forging to the front and leading throughout, scoring by one length. Expected to be in the finish. DUNSMORE FLYER (1) missed the placings here last start but is well-placed to atone.
